plugin.name: Shoko
plugin.description:
A Jellyfin plugin to integrate [Jellyfin](https://jellyfin.org/docs/) with [Shoko Server](https://shokoanime.com/downloads/shoko-server/).
## Read this before installing
**This plugin requires that you have already set up and are using Shoko Server**, and that the files you intend to include in Jellyfin are **indexed** (and optionally managed) by Shoko Server. **Otherwise, the plugin won't be able to provide metadata for your files**, since there is no metadata to find for them.
plugin.overview: Manage your anime from Jellyfin using metadata from Shoko

plugin.name: SmartCovers
plugin.overview: Cover extraction for books, audiobooks, comics, and music — with online fallback via Open Library & Google Books.
plugin.description: Cover provider for Jellyfin libraries. Renders PDF first pages with a built-in PDFium, takes the image named as the cover, else the first page, of CBZ and CBR comics, finds the cover inside EPUB and MOBI files, and pulls embedded artwork from audio files and folder audiobooks with Jellyfin's ffmpeg. When the file has no cover and online fetching is on (the default), fetches one from Open Library and then Google Books.

version.changelog: Audiobooks that are a folder of tracks get a cover: the book identity now comes from the folder (climbing out of disc folders), covers already on disk are found under any name, folder items get a cover, and one lookup serves a whole book. MOBI/AZW covers. A daily scheduled task retries items that never got a cover. Edition and narration tags are stripped before searching. A crafted MOBI header can no longer index past the record.
